name: Do I need an architect for a home addition, or can a builder handle the design?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect for a home addition, or can a builder handle the design?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most significant home additions, especially those involving structural changes or new living spaces, an architect is highly recommended. An architect provides expertise in design, functionality, structural integrity, and navigating local building codes. While some builders offer design-build services with in-house designers, an independent architect can offer a distinct perspective and ensure the design meets your specific aesthetic and functional goals before construction begins. Their plans are critical for permitting.
acceptedAnswer.description: For significant home additions, an architect is recommended for design expertise, structural integrity, and navigating building codes. Some builders offer design services, but an architect ensures comprehensive planning and permitting.
